desc: 派对聚餐一次性印花纸盘套图，从白底整摞主图到上桌盛装与规格选款收口
name: 家居派对一次性印花盛装纸盘款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼看清整摞家庭装的份量感与花色边带，赢下点击
一秒讲清花色边饰与空盘容量，把卖点主张位留给后期文案
用同机位双栏呈现普通薄盘承托满盘时软塌倾斜的尴尬，激化换新盘的动机
双手端盘上桌的真实动作让买家代入家庭聚餐，承载主力使用画面
俯拍一整套摆桌，证明盛装正餐与餐具同框的居家聚会氛围
微距证明卷边与压纹做工，用可见质感替代任何参数主张
保留双栏对照与属性行的说服结构，把两侧具体主张全部留白
同花色多规格矩阵加一枚标记箭头，帮买家挑到本 listing 的规格
用花园处理场景与留白印章框承接环保信任叙事，不做任何认证与主张
收口把整摞存货与已摆好的餐桌同框，暗示一次备齐的下单理由

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale sage #EEF2E0 for benefit and line-up screens, warm linen #F3E7DC for pain-point panels, real table textiles for lifestyle frames, single navy #1E3C72 band for the close
style.direction: bright everyday tableware commerce with clean infographic screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms in one accent, small shield-free utility glyphs, flat circular seal frames left empty
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral soft studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadows that always ground the product; lifestyle frames switch to 5500K window or late-afternoon sun with the same left-side direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright premium everyday-tableware visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale sage #EEF2E0, navy #1E3C72 text and header bands, and one coral #E8734A accent; neutral soft studio lighting with a front-left key, fill card and soft contact shadows that always ground the product; modern geometric sans-serif, all rendered copy left to post production; consistent thin single-weight line icon style and empty circular seal frames; clean high-end tableware product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, stable printed rim pattern, single face-up or clean side-profile presentation; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no redesign of the printed rim pattern
style.presentationRules: printed rim border always intact and repeated consistently across screens, plates shown face-up from above or in clean side profile as a wrapped stack, stable scale between the pack and single pieces
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale tablecloths and linen runners #D7E6E4 and #DFE3E1, neutral putty board #E9E3DA for macro, checked cloth for dining overheads
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline and label copy added in post only, generated frames keep empty label bars with no legible characters
